text.p: The following reports were broadcasted on Lithuania's M1 Plus radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The World Bank held a seminar in parliament on the structure and organisation of the institution.
- MP Kestutis Glaveckas said the government's intention to compensate the population for lost bank deposits will not solve the country's economic problems.
- A cabinet meeting is to decide on loans from the European Investment bank to finance Lithuanian railway's upgrading works.
